label: copy-phase recall of tokens 3-4 in long sequences, specific token pairs (sparse, weak)
explanation: Very sparse (0.03% of steps) and weak. Fires only in the copy phase, almost always when recalling original token 3 or 4 (t=11-13) in L=8 or L=9 sequences; never in the original or delimiter phases, and essentially never for L<=7. That positional window alone covers 98.6% of activation mass but has 0.5% precision. Inside it, firing is enriched for input i (strongest, about 39% of mass), o or x, and output i/r/o/l, but no token rule is clean: the best token-pair predicate gets dev F1 0.21 (precision 0.15, recall 0.35). The largest activations are on input i at recall_idx 3 in L=9 sequences, often when the next output is also i. Looks like a diffuse token-by-position conjunction with no compact description.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=i (+4.36), phase=2 & in_tok=x (+3.43), phase=2 & in_tok=o (+3.37), phase=2 & in_tok=d (+2.50), phase=2 & out_tok=i (+2.32), recall_idx=4 (+2.27). Lower it: prev_tok=o (-1.68), orig6=- (-1.67), orig7=- (-1.60), to_go=1 (-1.32).
